name: Export window plan and aliases
summary: Labels 7/30/90 get days_used = min(label, days); labels already covered by a smaller label are aliases, copied at load; partial windows marked in the app.

name: As-of cutoff
summary: Reads stop before audit_today(); dbt excludes today, direct export with include_today=true cuts at tomorrow (today partial).

name: Export row cap and truncation
summary: LIMIT max_rows + 1 per check run (50,000 default, 500,000 on Refresh); truncated recorded per check and window and shown by the API.

name: dbt lineage: system.* to app tables
summary: Sources -> findings/tags/dims via ref() edges; direct export as second road; examples from billing row to Chargeback.

name: Loader internals (order inside _load_root)
summary: findings + alias copies, dims, tags (key trim, alias copies), reconciliation unit_*, bill over perf, workspace.csv, other schemas, entitlements, meta, local RLS cut, os.replace, run_results.
